name: MTN Nigeria
source: MTN Nigeria Communications Plc. Revenue from the NGX filing library H1 2026 earnings release and the audited FY2025 results. CRON 2026-11-06: Cost of Sales, Gross Profit and Operating Expenses corrected to the figures the issuer prints, and the H1 2026 cost lines added, all in NGN millions scaled to absolute naira. FY2025 earnings release, salient points table, read 2026-11-06: total revenue 5,202,957, expenses 2,460,864, cost of sales 688,269, operating expenses 1,772,595, EBITDA 2,743,765 (FY2024: revenue 3,358,461, expenses 2,047,431, cost of sales 528,185, operating expenses 1,519,246, EBITDA 1,313,399). Gross profit is revenue less cost of sales because the issuer splits its expenses into exactly those two lines: FY2025 5,202,957 less 688,269 equals 4,514,688, and 4,514,688 less 1,772,595 plus other income 1,672 equals the printed EBITDA 2,743,765; FY2024 3,358,461 less 528,185 equals 2,830,276, and 2,830,276 less 1,519,246 plus other income 2,369 equals the printed EBITDA 1,313,399. H1 2026 from the half year earnings release, read 2026-11-06: total revenue 2,993,064, expenses 1,319,544 made up of cost of sales 376,096 and operating expenses 943,449, EBITDA 1,673,519. Gross profit 2,616,968 is revenue less cost of sales; the segmental table in the same release prints a gross margin of 2,616,969, one million higher on rounding. The cells replaced were cost of sales 895,102 and 696,682 and operating expenses 0 and 0 for FY2025 and FY2024, none of which matched the printed lines, and the two zeros rendered as 0.0 on the panel. FY2021 to FY2023 are left as collected because each of those years already ties revenue less cost of sales to its stored gross profit and cost of sales plus operating expenses to its stored operating profit. Source URL https://doclib.ngxgroup.com/Financial_NewsDocs/MTN_Nigeria_FY_2025_Earnings_Release.pdf | income tax row corrected from the issuer's audited statement so that Profit Before Tax less Income Tax equals Net Profit
